name: Lars
desc:
Lars is a Khan NPC. He is a member of [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions) and currently belong to the 11th Scouting Legion. He stays with his group composed of of [Atra](entity:atra), [Caitus](entity:caitus), [Gaius](entity:gaius) and [Amara](entity:amara).

He is part of the 'Legion Scout' quest and is the person [Atra](entity:atra) asks you to find.
